page_note: Heavily damaged page (81.8%) but recoverable structure: an extended cosmological simile of the hidden/free woman who only reveals her face by necessity, applied to the Third Ambassador (ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ) — a classic Persian/Manichaean cosmological substrate figure. The teaching maps cosmos→cosmos: woman behind her chamber → Ambassador hidden from archons; her revealed face → his manifest image; archons' desire → fashioning of Adam and Eve. Substrate dominates. Editorial application appears in segs 25-28 where the speaker pivots to address the disciples ("Behold then I have raised you up", "the question you asked", "I shall teach you"). Then substrate resumes 29-32 with the divinity-with-powers and angels imprinting the image. The fatigue score (+15 substrate in 2nd half) reflects the simile→ambassador→Adam-fashioning teaching being densest at end, after a brief frame intrusion.
